title: Children taught physics by 'the ghost'
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Children taught physics by 'the ghost', about recent at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've met with some families where the kids I've been graciously allowed to speak with the kids and the kids have said Well, the the the um the the the ghost comes and tells me.

plain: A man named Dave Rossi says he has met families whose children, when he was allowed to speak with them, told him that "the ghost" comes and tells them things. In the podcast where he tells this, the claim is that these visits teach the children advanced physics. If true, it would mean some unseen presence is passing knowledge to children.
